entities.name: Library Management System
entities.description: A cloud-native enterprise solution that enables public and academic libraries to catalogue physical and digital items, manage circulation, and provide self-service portals with EU-only data residency and security compliance.

entities.name: Library Patrons
entities.description: Students and public users accessing self-service portals.

entities.name: Librarians / Circulation Staff
entities.description: Staff managing item cataloguing and circulation workflows.

entities.name: Library Administrators
entities.description: Personnel managing system reporting, inventory, and budgets.

entities.name: Digital Content Providers
entities.description: External e-Book Vendors providing digital content.

entities.name: Notification Service
entities.description: External service for sending system notifications.

interfaces.description: Manage system reporting, inventory, and budgets

naming_conventions: Users and actors are pluralized or clearly designated roles (e.g., 'Library Patrons', 'Library Administrators').
External systems are named after their functional domain (e.g., 'Payment Gateway', 'Identity Provider').
